topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't shake the thought. It's as if the world has narrowed down to this one revelation. I stroll through the park, the same park where it all became too clear. They're here, in this city, just around the corner maybe, and I never knew. The air seems thicker, every step heavier. How many times have we passed each other, oblivious? Now, every face in the crowd feels like it could be them. I find myself looking for a stranger who isn’t really a stranger anymore, yet I still know so little. It’s a maze of what-ifs and maybes, and I’m stuck in the middle, hoping for a sign, a nod, anything to bridge the distance between our worlds.
